subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Bully
solution: The correct answer is: **Oppressor**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"bully"** refers to a person who habitually seeks to harm or intimidate those whom they perceive as vulnerable. (धौंस जमाने वाला) • **Example: **He stood up to the bully who had been tormenting his friend. • **"Oppressor" **is someone who keeps others down by the cruel use of power. (अत्याचारी) • **Example: **The dictator was seen as an oppressor by the people of his country. • Hence, we can infer that a synonym for **'bully' **is **'oppressor'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Oppressor**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Plough **(हल): A large farming implement with one or more blades fixed in a frame, used to turn over and cut through the soil to prepare it for planting. • **Example:** The farmer used a plough to prepare the field for the new crop. • **Oxen **(बैल): Domesticated bovine animals used for pulling heavy loads. • **Example: **The oxen were yoked to the cart to transport the goods. • **Coddle** (लाड़ प्यार करना): Treat in an indulgent or overprotective way. • **Example:** She used to coddle her younger brother, much to his annoyance. 11e:Td0f,
